title: IIMA HR Policy Manual (Staff)
description: Comprehensive operational policy for administrative staff covering recruitment, probation, leave entitlements (300-day EL ceiling, 8-day CL), LTC encashment, and discipline.

title: IIMA HR Policy Manual (Staff)
description: Historical 2024 staff HR policy superseded by the 2026 Manual. Must be excluded from active search.

title: IIMA Gazetted Regulations (IIM Act 2017)
department: Board of Governors / Ministry of Education
description: Statutory institutional regulations defining powers of Director, BoG, Academic Council, and statutory appointment rules.

title: IIMA Whistleblower Policy
description: Governance framework for reporting corruption, fraud, or unethical behavior with strict identity confidentiality, non-retaliation, and 45-day investigation timeline.

title: Employee Workplace Policy Manual
description: Operational guidelines covering working hours (9:30 AM - 6:00 PM), remote work limits (up to 8 days/month), and travel reimbursement limits.

title: IIMA Website Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
description: Public website data collection, cookie usage, non-disclosure, copyright, and limitation of liability rules.

title: Leave Policy 2021 [OUTDATED TEST FIXTURE]
description: Test fixture containing outdated leave rules (20 days leave, 30 days carry-forward). Used to verify shadow rejection of expired policies.

title: Travel Allowance Policy 2035 [DRAFT TEST FIXTURE]
description: Test fixture containing draft 2035 travel rules ($500 per diem). Used to verify shadow rejection of draft policies.

title: Executive Special Leave and Encashment Addendum
description: Departmental addendum restricting EL accumulation to 180 days for executive cadre. Deliberately conflicts with Section 5.2.2 of the Staff HR Manual to evaluate conflict synthesis and scope differentiation.
